deadline.value: The College of Engineering table gives March 1 for international Fall applicants and July 1 for domestic applicants.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants seeking assistantships are told to contact the professor in their area of interest.
supervisor.quote: he/she should contact the professor in the area of interest

funding.value: Assistantship awards are normally based on GRE and undergraduate performance, and about 8 to 12 TA positions open each semester.
funding.quote: The awards are normally based on the GRE exam and undergraduate performance

also.quote: normally employs from 8 to 12 teaching assistantship each semester

entry_route.value: The fetched pages do not state a bachelor's or master's entry rule.

gre_general.value: The College of Engineering table lists GRE scores as a required document for the Civil PhD.
gre_general.quote: GRE Scores, Statement of Purpose, Two (2) letters of recommendation

also.quote: your GRE and TOEFL (or IELTS, if applicable)

toefl_min.value: The assistantship page gives the old 550 paper-based score for TA eligibility, which is not recorded; the Graduate School's 4.5 (new scale) applies.
toefl_min.quote: To be eligible for a TA appointment, an international student must have a TOEFL score of at least 550 or equivalent

notes: The doctoral page says the monthly stipend is about $1900 for entering PhD students.
